# Empty

What a view shows when it has nothing to show. It says what belongs here, why it is empty, and what to do next; it never leaves a blank area and never apologizes.

**Kind:** Pattern

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/storybook-docs/patterns/Empty/Empty.mdx`

## The types

Choose among four situations to set the wording and available action. See Empty state for props.

- **First use.** Nothing has been added yet. Say what will appear and give the one action that adds it, if this person can.
- **No matches.** A search or filter matched nothing. Name what is active and offer "Reset filters".
- **All done.** The person finished everything. Say so, and when more arrives. No action.
- **Can't show.** The data could not load, or this person has no access. Say why and give a way forward: Try again, or who can help.

## Where it sits

The place sets the spacing and the alignment. The words stay the same.

- **A full page.** The block lines up with the page title, left-aligned with no wide margin, the picture above the text. The block is centered today.
- **In a table.** The empty state replaces the whole table: no column headers, no footer. The block is centered and its text stays left-aligned. The Table keeps its header row and centers the text today.
- **In a card.** Compact: a smaller picture and heading, the block centered in the card, the text left-aligned. Several cards at once drop their pictures and use Subtle actions. The text is centered today.
- **In a Panel.** The Details Panel when its record was removed: the block at the top of the body, with a way back.

## Key cases

## Usage

Use Empty when a list, table, card, Panel or page has no records to show, a search or filter returns nothing, a queue is finished, or the content exists but cannot be shown to this person. Show Loading instead while content is on its way, and leave one blank field blank.

| Type | The view is empty because | Say | Action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| First use | Nothing has been added yet: a new group with no students | What will appear here and how it gets here | One Primary, if this person can add something; otherwise none |
| No matches | A search or filter matched nothing | Which search or filters are active | "Reset filters" as a Default button; it also clears the search |
| All done | The person finished everything: every reflection is reviewed | That they are done, and when more arrives | None |
| Can't show | No access, or the data could not load | Why, in plain words | Try again, or who can help; never an action they cannot take |

## Alternatives

- For content still on its way, follow Loading: a skeleton, not an empty state.
- For a save or request that failed while the view still has content, use `SectionMessage`; the Errors pattern says where each failure shows.
- For one blank value in a record, show a dash, not an empty state.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Heading: "No students in this group yet". | "No data", "Nothing here", "Oops!". |
| One line: "Add students to schedule sessions and track their progress." | A paragraph about the feature. |
| Action names the next step: "Add students". | "Get started", "Continue". |
| No matches: "No students match these filters." with "Reset filters". | "Clear filters", "Clear all". |
| All done: "Every reflection is reviewed. New ones arrive after Friday's sessions." | "All caught up! 🎉" |
| Warmer for students, plainer for admins: "Your tutor will add notes after your session." and "No notes for this group." | One voice for everyone. |

## Accessibility

- The heading is one level below the section that holds it, so it joins the page outline.
- The picture is decorative: an empty alt, or `aria-hidden` on an icon.
- When a filter or search empties a list, the result count is announced in a polite live region ("0 students").
- Focus stays where it was. Never move it to the empty state's button.

## Parts

| Part | Component | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The block | Empty state | Picture or icon, header, one line and the action; `spacing` is `default` for a view and `compact` for a table body or card. |
| The action | Button | `primaryAction` takes one Button; a No matches action is Default. |
| Table slot | Table | `emptyState` takes the block. It replaces the whole table, header and footer included. |
| In a Panel | Panel | The record-gone state at the top of the body. |

## Related

- Loading: use before you know the view is empty.
- Errors: use for the words in a Can't show state.
- Filtering: use for where No matches comes from, and the "Reset filters" wording.
- Search: use for a search that matches nothing.
- Section: use for the view bar that stays above a replaced table.

## Best practices

### Show an `EmptyState` in any view that has no records. {#show-an-emptystate-in-any-view-that-has-no-records}

**Checked:** Review

Never a blank area or a bare "No results": a blank reads as broken or still loading.

Do: Say what belongs here and give the one action that fills it.
Don't: A bare string in an empty box: broken, loading or empty, nobody can tell.

### Lay the text out as a left-aligned block. {#lay-the-text-out-as-a-left-aligned-block}

**Checked:** Review

The picture above, then the heading, one line and the action, all on one left edge. On a full page the block lines up with the page title; inside a table or a card the block is centered and its text stays left-aligned. The text column never runs wide.  `EmptyState` centers its text today.

### Replace the whole table with the empty state. {#replace-the-whole-table-with-the-empty-state}

**Checked:** Review

No column headers and no footer while the table is empty; the view bar above stays, so the person can change the view, search or reset. A "No matches" state offers "Reset filters".  The Table keeps its header row in its `emptyState` slot today.

Do: The whole table replaced; the view bar stays.
Don't: Column headers and a footer over nothing, with a centered paragraph.

### Give at most one Primary action. {#give-at-most-one-primary-action}

**Checked:** Review

The second action is Default and never stands alone. When two or more empty states can show on one screen, none of them uses a Primary; their actions are Subtle.

### Offer only an action this person can take. {#offer-only-an-action-this-person-can-take}

**Checked:** Review

If they cannot add anything, show no button. A button that leads to "You don't have permission" is a dead end.

### Write the heading as what belongs here. {#write-the-heading-as-what-belongs-here}

**Checked:** Review

"No students in this group yet". The view is empty, not wrong, so the heading carries no "Sorry", no "Oops" and no code.

### Mark the picture as decorative. {#mark-the-picture-as-decorative}

**Checked:** Automatic

Screen readers skip it and read the heading first; the words carry the meaning. The `EmptyState` hides its picture and icon from assistive technology, and its heading sits one level below the section that holds it.

### Name the active search or filters in a No matches state. {#name-the-active-search-or-filters-in-a-no-matches-state}

**Checked:** Review

The person may not remember a filter set last week. "No students match these filters" with "Reset filters" is the way out.

### Use an illustration once and an icon where it repeats. {#use-an-illustration-once-and-an-icon-where-it-repeats}

**Checked:** Review

An illustration for a full view a person meets once, such as a new tutor's first day; an icon on anything that repeats, such as a card on a home page. Illustrations arrive with the character work .
